name: Cao lau
summary: Cao lau is Hoi An’s noodle dish: chewy noodles, a little broth, pork, herbs, and crackers. It is not a soup you drink. The noodles are the point, and they belong to this town.
origin: Hoi An. Recipes elsewhere are approximations.
howToEat: Toss the bowl so the pork and greens coat the noodles.
Eat it at lunch. A shop that also sells mi Quang is a normal sign, not a lack of focus.
where: Eat the bowl in Hoi An, at lunch. If you are staying in Da Nang and the ride is not the plan, Hoài Phố at 255 Nguyễn Chí Thanh serves it. Judge the dish in Hoi An.
priceBand: A single bowl is a cheap lunch.
seoDescription: What cao lau is and why you should eat it in Hoi An.
